budget.clock_start: M3 bind start before first bootstrap writer; the direct-runtime probe is separate historical observation before the bootstrap start, and its three capture files are not bootstrap bytes.
budget.clock_stop: M3 end after stdout, stderr and immutable exit are fsynced and directory synced; only a committed qualified final receipt authorizes consumption. Canonical final bytes are written exclusively to .final.pending, file and directory fsynced, then a fresh M3 reading must be within deadline before os.link publishes .final and the directory is fsynced again. Pending is never authority; post-link directory-fsync failure exits nonzero with durable content and uncertain directory-entry durability. READY/GO budget is deadline minus M3 GO-send reading minus sealed transit margin; Intel binding checks T0 plus budget before each identity measurement, at probe-source line events through entry/chunk loops, and immediately before success output, with T0 read before verification. Initial bundle read, blocking I/O and remote process lifetime remain open. Hard M3 timeout at original bind start plus 870 seconds.

child_contract.requirement: Before acquisition: bind executable digest, bounded output behavior, max-filesize enforcement for unknown-length responses, redirects, trust store and child write roots to reviewed Intel receipts; no MacPorts subprocess is dispatched.

collector.execution_authority: NONE from this packet; modes and write-root names describe future admitted collection, not authorization.
collector.root_contract: Named retained root must be new/empty at window start, user-owned 0700 and on this host; same bound core and retained directory on every invocation. Evidence updates use only the sealed slots and chained ledger without resetting the clock. No retry, reset, cleanup, symlink-root traversal or cross-host transfer. Other roots are read-only observations of future install write scopes.

preinstall.requirement: Explicit preinstall identities only; postinstall observations and explanatory status/availability/BLOCKED notes are never preinstall requirements. Actual source-image chain and handoff remain open in R1C report; guard comparison is not execution permission.

window_seal.binding: MAESTRO captures direct-runtime Intel probe as separate observation before bootstrap, binds, commits capture + stderr + exit + qualified final + hash before inventory within the original 870 s window, then commits every M3 attempt and its stdout/stderr/exit/final/pending companions; pending is charged evidence, never authority. Consumed anchors are never reused; unknown outcomes need operator-reviewed recovery.
window_seal.ledger: evidence.jsonl inside retained_dir; add-only slots, SHA-256 chain rooted in the core seal; immutable per-record head receipts detect truncation; interrupted appends refuse.
